method: AI visual inspection of six contact sheets generated from the current real-Chrome matrix; not owner/human signoff.

checks.detail: Page title, breadcrumb, primary action, panels and status footer form a consistent hierarchy across all 19 routes.
Six primary navigation items remain fixed and selected parent state is visually distinct.
At 360x740, long tables and content use internal scrolling; no blocking page-level clipping or overlapping fixed actions was observed.
All 12 dialog types keep title, body and footer visible at 360x740; candidate/model lists scroll internally and footer actions remain reachable.
Dark and light themes preserve spacing, hierarchy, control affordances and status semantics.
At 1440x900, panels use the available width without empty fragmented layouts or overlapping controls.
Narrow view is dense but readable; no truncated primary labels or inaccessible icon-only actions were observed.

observations: The narrow topbar intentionally wraps the non-production badge and refresh control; no collision was observed.
Pool strategy/app/test routes share the same pool shell with distinct panels; this is consistent with the six-primary-navigation information architecture.
Some secondary metadata is visually compact at 360px; retained as a watch item, not a blocking defect.
limitations: This is an AI visual review, not the owner's human visual signoff.
OS-native IME candidate-window presentation and audible Orca listening were not assessed.
Contact-sheet thumbnails do not replace the full-resolution matrix screenshots.
